questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (around 00:09-00:11), there are clearly three pen-like objects arranged in a row.
The leftmost pen has a pointed tip at the bottom, while the middle and right pens have black caps at the bottom. They are not aligned identically in terms of features (capped vs uncapped).
The middle and right pens have black caps, while the leftmost pen does not have a black cap, making its appearance different.
The leftmost pen shows a bare, pointed writing tip (or is a refill) at the bottom, whereas the other two pens are capped with black caps.
The board moves smoothly and continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is missing its cap (showing a bare tip/refill) while the other two pens are capped, violating the condition that all pens must be complete and capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
